column3: MT 83:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; צְפוּנֶיךָ (“your hidden ones”) is rendered “Your sheltered ones.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with heart together” is rendered “with one consent,” and “a covenant” “a confederacy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they have become an arm to” is rendered “They have helped.”
Close to the Hebrew; דֹּמֶן (“dung”) is rendered “refuse.”
